glyph_provenance.method: Complete 0..9 measured photo traces of current Nike team jerseys sold by official club shops, accessed 2026-10-05. No marketing font used. Horizontal tilt and vertical lean flattened; measured repeated-digit perspective calibration applied only to leading numerals.
glyph_provenance.limitation: Photo-derived outlines approximate printed contours; they are not exact licensed jersey-font files. Product camera perspective and print shadows limit precision. Existing native fill/outline colours, outline fractions and registration retained.

venue.notes: Reliant Stadium (the Texans' own 2026 pages use this name again, so the retail stadium_name cut-out stays). 2026 kickoff field (houstontexans.com field-painting gallery): black end zones with white TEXANS at one end and HOUSTON at the other, the bull (white with a black keyline and star) at the left of each word and the H-Town blackletter H at the right; a white bull with a black keyline at midfield. s37 has ONE end-zone texture set for both ends, so both ends read TEXANS (a writer limit). The H-Town H is not drawn: no official vector (open item).

roster.note: nflverse roster_2026 week 3 active list; 2026 depth charts list a 4-3 front (LDE, LDT, RDT, RDE, WLB, MLB, SLB).
